text:
mari torres: FYI - nightly perf alerted on a regression after the kernel-autotuner change - ~8-12% p95 on GQA multiq runs.
infra-bot: [perf-alert] job=nightly/gqa-multiq, build=redwood/runtime@a7f3d2, check=latency-p95, delta=+9.6% :eyes:
ajay singh: can you paste the exact numbers and which model/config was used?
mari torres: model=mpt-30b-gqa, batch=8, seq=1024/2048 mix, kv-layout=paged-kv, block_size=256 (new default). p95 baseline=72ms current=79ms. end-to-end throughput stable but tail moved. test harness: /test/perf/gqa/multiq/bench.sh (uses --warm 100 --iters 200).
kevin wu: suspicious — the autotuner bumped the kernel pick to paged-attn-v2 for MQA paths when frag_ratio>0.3. that kernel assumes denser KV stripes; with block_size=256 we might be getting worse prefetch locality.
sophie lee: attached a quick perf sample (flamegraph): https://perf.internal/reports/2460123456/flame.svg - you can see memcopy spikes around 0.6s for many threads, and an extra dispatch hop in paged-attn-v2. :thinking:
ajay singh: can you run the microbench that isolates kernel selection? something like: 
```
./tools/bench_kernel --model mpt-30b --seq 1024 --batch 1 --kv-layout paged --block 128,256,512 --profile
```
I want to see sign of memcpy + kernel launch cost across block sizes.
kevin wu: sharing the autotune snippet that landed (from PR):
```json
{"autotune": {"seq_buckets": [512,1024,2048], "decision": {"frag_ratio_thresh": 0.3, "pick": "paged-attn-v2", "fallback": "gqa-legacy"}}}
```
kevin wu: if frag_ratio calc is off (we saw a counting bug earlier), it would force v2 on cases it shouldn't. also v2 does an extra KV remap pass on MQA which is O(blocks).
mari torres: dug into logs: when block_size=256 and seq=1024, frag_ratio reported ~0.45 and we go v2 -> memcopy increase ~6-8ms per request. excerpt: 
```
[2026-03-15T02:14:33Z] kvpager: blocks=12 live=7 frag_ratio=0.45
[2026-03-15T02:14:33Z] kernel_picker: selected=paged-attn-v2 reason=frag_ratio>0.3
[2026-03-15T02:14:33Z] paged-attn-v2: remap_bytes=1234576 memcpy_ms=7.6 launch_ms=0.9
```
sophie lee: quick mitigation: lower autotune frag threshold to 0.6 in canary or revert default block_size to 128. which is safer for tonight? :bug:
ajay singh: revert block_size to 128 is low-risk and should show if layout was the main culprit. I can kick a canary with block_size=128 on the same canary pool.
infra-bot: canary-deploy requested by ajay singh - target=canary/gqa-multiq, config_override={"kv_block_size":128}, queued.
kevin wu: if block_size=128 fixes perf, we should follow up with a fix: either adjust frag_ratio calc (I have a PR drafted) or make autotune consider remap_cost estimate when choosing v2.
ajay singh: running the bench now, will post numbers (ETA ~12m).
mari torres: thanks all — please @here when you have numbers. if revert needed we'll schedule roll-back window. :thumbsup:
